body:
**Mondo term (ID and Label)**
'heart, malformation of'
MONDO:0009327

**Reason for deprecation**
This term is a phenotype or a historical term (probably a placeholder for other more specific diseases).
The two OMIM xrefs that were equivalent to this term have been moved to two separate OMIM terms, indicating that they were referring to different diseases. 
OMIM:140500 --> OMIM:306955 - 'congenital heart defects, multiple types, 1, X-linked' (MONDO:0800321)
OMIM:234750 --> OMIM:614980 - 'congenital heart defects, multiple types, 2' (MONDO:0014000)

**Suggested term to consider**
'heart disorder' (MONDO:0005267)

**Your nano-attribution (ORCID)**
If you don't have an ORCID, you can sign up for one [here](https://orcid.org/)
